time.name: Name

time.logTimeHint: Calls, meetings and anything done away from Claude Code and git.
time.empty: No time recorded in this period.

time.idleHint: A pause longer than this ends a work block.
time.parallelHint: Time spent on projects in parallel counts for each of them, so rows can add up to more than the time worked.

finance.earnedHint: Accrued from your agreements in this period
finance.perHourHint: Margin divided by the hours you worked
finance.overhead: Includes {amount} of costs not tied to a project (shared costs in months without hours, AI used outside projects).

finance.owedHint: Everything earned so far minus what has been paid. Negative amounts are prepaid credit.
finance.noAgreements: No agreement yet. Add an hourly rate, a fixed price or a recurring fee.
finance.sharedHint: Costs that serve many projects (a server, a tool subscription). Each month they are split across projects by hours worked.
finance.aiPlansHint: Without a plan, mmp uses the cost Claude Code reports (pay-as-you-go). With a subscription, the monthly fee is split across projects by usage.
finance.noPlans: No plan set: pay-as-you-go costs are used.
finance.usdRateHint: Used to convert AI costs, which Claude Code reports in dollars.
finance.showMinor: Show {n} projects without revenue ({hours}, {costs} of costs)
